note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. Two contests, Magherally and Ballybrick (Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1958, p. 5; Irish News, 6 June 1958, p. 1). The other eighteen divisions are from the returning officer's notice of result (Banbridge Chronicle, 13 June 1958, p. 4): fourteen members returned unopposed and, with no nomination for Gilford, Loughbrickland, Scarva and Tullylish, their retiring members deemed to be re-elected (round 2, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
